The motion of particle clusters in the vicinity of the wall of a CFB can be analyzed using a force balance.

the contact time of a particle cluster with a surface is proportional to the square root of the cluster diameter, and that the particle-gas heat transfer coefficient in a CFB can be estimated by the following formula: h = 0.0025Re0.6Pr0.33.
a new theory was developed that accurately predicts the particle-gas convective heat transfer coefficient in the near wall region of a CFB.

the following topics: (1) the forces affecting the motion and contact time of particle cluster near the wall of CFB, (2) the theoretical analysis and experimental study on convection heat transfer of particle clusters near wall, and (3) the experimental study on heat transfer of CFB.
a theoretical analysis of particle clusters motion and convection heat transfer near the wall of the circulating fluidized bed.
the analysis of particle motion and convection heat transfer of particles in a circulating fluidized bed.

this paper provides a theoretical basis for the heat transfer coefficient in a CFB.

the convection heat-transfer coefficient is proportional to the particle velocity near the wall.
we were able to develop a model for the particle cluster motion and the heat transfer coefficient for a CFB.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the particle-gas convective heat transfer coefficient in a CFB is strongly dependent on the gas velocity and particle size and is independent of the particle density, particle temperature, and particle concentration in the bed.
the convection heat-transfer coefficient is strongly influenced by the particle-gas contact time and that the contact time is strongly influenced by particle-wall collisions.
the convection heat-transfer coefficient is a function of the particle size and the particle cluster size.
